blocks.text: Ek sehatmand janwar mein androoni (internal) tissues, jaise khoon, dimagh aur pattha (muscle), aam tor par microorganisms se paak hote hain. Satah (surface) ke tissues, jaise jild (skin) aur mucous membranes, hamesha mahol se rabte mein hote hain aur un par kuch microbial species aabad (colonised) hoti hain. Jism ki kisi bhi jagah par baqaida milne wale jandaron ke mixture ko normal flora kehte hain.

blocks.title: Normal flora
blocks.text: Jism ki kisi khaas jagah, jaise jild, munh ya aant, par baqaida milne wale microorganisms ka mixture. Insaan mein yeh bacteria, chand fungi aur protists, aur kuch methanogenic archaea par mushtamil hai; bacteria is ke sab se zyada tadaad wale aur numayan (obvious) arkaan hain.

Insaan aur us ke normal flora ka rishta mutualistic hai: dono ko faida hota hai. Insaani jism mein normal flora ko ghiza (nutrients), mustaqil (stable) mahol, ek jaisa darja-e-hararat (temperature), hifazat (protection) aur safar (transport) milta hai. Badle mein jism ko apne normal bacteria se kai faide milte hain.
Insaan ke bacterial flora ke faide

items: Vitamins ki tayyari: alimentary canal ke bacteria vitamins banate hain aur apni zaroorat se zyada vitamins kharij (excrete) kar dete hain. Yeh vitamins alimentary canal se jazb (absorb) ho kar jism mein taqseem hote hain. Enteric bacteria vitamin K aur vitamin B12 nikalte hain, aur lactic acid bacteria kuch B vitamins banate hain.

Pathogens ko aabad hone se rokna: normal flora ke bacteria pathogens se jurne ki jagahon (attachment sites) aur ghiza ke liye muqabla karte hain, to pathogens ko jism ke tissues mein dakhil hone ka mauqa kam milta hai.
Pathogens ko rokna ya maarna: aant ke bacteria mukhtalif aise maddey banate hain jo pathogenic bacteria ko rokte ya maarte hain.

Cross-reactive antibodies ki tahreek: chunke normal flora antigens ki tarah kaam karta hai, yeh immunological jawab paida karta hai. Normal flora ke khilaf bani kam miqdaar ki antibodies kuch pathogens se cross-react karti hain aur is tarah infection ya hamle ko rokti hain.

blocks.prompt: Normal flora pathogens ko bahar rakhne ke do tareeqe aur do vitamins batayein jo yeh faraham karta hai.
blocks.explanation: Yeh pathogens se jurne ki jagahon aur ghiza ke liye muqabla karta hai, aur aise maddey banata hai jo unhen rokte ya maarte hain (iske khilaf bani antibodies bhi kuch pathogens se cross-react karti hain). Enteric bacteria vitamin K aur vitamin B12 dete hain; lactic acid bacteria kuch B vitamins.

items: Androoni tissues aam tor par microbes se paak hote hain; satah ke tissues par normal flora hota hai jo zyadatar bacteria, chand fungi, protists aur methanogenic archaea par mushtamil hai.
Rishta mutualistic hai: flora ko ghiza, mustaqil ghar, hifazat aur safar milta hai.
Jism ko vitamins (K, B12, kuch B vitamins), pathogens ke aabad hone se hifazat, pathogen maarne wale maddey aur cross-reactive antibodies milti hain.
